title_sq: RRUGA E ELBASANIT, SHESIM APARTAMENT OPEN SPACE ME VERANDE
description_sq:
Shesim apartament open space me verand te Rruga e Elbasanit, prane Fakultetit Ekonomik.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 10 banim (i fundit) i nje ndertimi te ri me ashensor. Apartament ka siperfaqe 220m2 neto dhe siperfaqe 110m2 te verandes me pamje te lire. 
Aktualisht eshte lene i painvestuar nga pronari, qe klienti bleres te kete mundesi pershtatje sipas deshires. 
Pallati eshte ndertim mjaft cilesor i vitit 2013 ne nje zone te qete dhe me akses direkt me Rrugen e Elbasanit. 
Apartamenti disponon Certifikate Pronesie.
Kontaktoni tani per nje vizite ne prone!
title_en: ELBASAN STREET, OPEN SPACE APARTMENT FOR SALE WITH VERANDA
description_en: We are selling an open space apartment with a veranda on Rruga e Elbasani, near the Faculty of Economics. The apartment is located on the 10th residential (last) floor of a new building with an elevator. The apartment has a net area of ​​220m2 and a veranda area of ​​110m2 with a free view. It is currently left uninvested by the owner, so that the buyer can customize it as desired. The palace is a very high-quality building from 2013 in a quiet area with direct access to Elbasan Street. The apartment has Ownership Certificates. Contact now for a visit to the property!
